name: Deep obsession
source:
You spend your nights online, looking at morbid stories about the cruelty of humanity. You've just finished reading a article about  reporters who have gone missing. They say it's because of a snuff streamer. You don't believe that.

What begins as you trying to prove the internet wrong ends with mutual obsession, blood, and a night to remember.

[From [url=https://crimsonfilled-studios.itch.io/deep-obsession]Itch.io[/url]]
